support.notes: Cartesian chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free engine: the web component props mapped to the same presets and engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset; hover/pointClick/plotClick/zoom events and a template ref handle (resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize). No WebGPU / WebGL renderer and no keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Combination chart
translationResources.description: Bars, lines and areas in one chart, on one or two value axes: revenue and growth, rainfall and temperature, Pareto charts.

revenue-growth.title: Revenue and growth
revenue-growth.description: The growth line sets yAxis: "right" and is drawn against yAxis2 with its own format; the right range is aligned on the left ticks, so the grid fits both axes.

climate.title: Climate chart
climate.description: Rainfall bars on the left axis and the temperature curve on the right axis; zero: true keeps zero in the right range.

conversion.title: Traffic and conversion
conversion.description: An area of daily sessions with the conversion rate on the right axis and a campaign highlighted by a rect annotation.

pareto.title: Pareto chart
pareto.description: Sorted causes with their cumulative share on a 0-100% right axis (min, max and nice: false); the causes behind 80% of the returns are highlighted.

log-scale.title: Log scale
log-scale.description: Users grow 6,000-fold in ten years: yAxis2={{ type: "log" }} draws them on a logarithmic right axis with its own decades, next to the revenue bars on the linear left axis; tooltips keep the actual values.

locale.title: Locales
locale.description: The same chart with locale="zh-CN" and locale="fr-FR": the engine writes the compact units (万 / k), the separators, the month names of the time axis and the tooltip dates of the locale. Without locale, charts follow the page language (<html lang>).

solar-battery.title: Solar and home battery
solar-battery.description: Hourly solar production as bars and consumption as a line on the left axis, the battery's state of charge as an area on yAxis2 fixed to 0–100% with min, max and nice: false; rect annotations shade the nights. The Switch hides the battery and the output recomputes the self-sufficiency.

inventory.title: Inventory and deliveries
inventory.description: A stepped area of the stock level with delivery bars, a reorder point line and a safety stock rect. onPointClick marks the day with an x line and shows its purchase order or stock in an output; onPlotClick clears it.

ops-overview.title: Operations overview
ops-overview.description: Request bars on the left axis, the error rate on the right axis, and the releases as a type: "scatter" series whose showLabels writes each version. Checkboxes replace the legend and set hidden on each series.

burndown.title: Sprint burndown
burndown.description: The remaining work as an area, the points completed each day as bars and the ideal burn as a line on explicit xAxis categories; a text annotation flags a scope change. renderTooltip tells how far ahead or behind the ideal line each day is.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Rainfall bars on the left axis and the temperature line on the right axis (yAxis: "right" and yAxis2); tap to compare both.

MixedChartProps.series: Bars, lines, areas and dots, each with its type; yAxis: "right" plots a series against yAxis2
MixedChartProps.yAxis2: Right value axis of the series with yAxis: "right"
MixedChartProps.orientation: "horizontal" puts the categories down the left side

ChartProps.series: Data series; each sets its own type
ChartProps.stackMode: "percent" scales every stack to 100% at each x
ChartProps.yAxis2: Right value axis of the series with yAxis: "right"; its range is aligned on the left ticks
ChartProps.orientation: "horizontal" puts the x axis (categories) down the left side and the values along the bottom

ChartLabels.outliers: Number of outliers of a box
ChartLabels.value: Scatter value (bubbles) when the series has no valueName
ChartLabels.x: Row of the x of a scatter point when the axis has no title
ChartLabels.y: Row of the y of a scatter point when the axis has no title
ChartLabels.chart: Accessible name of a chart without series
ChartLabels.chartOf: Accessible name of a chart; {series} is the list of the series names
ChartLabels.start: Start of a range bar on a time axis (Gantt tasks)
ChartLabels.end: End of a range bar on a time axis
ChartLabels.duration: Length of a range bar on a time axis (4 weeks, 26 days)
ChartLabels.progress: Done share of a Gantt task
ChartLabels.dependencies: Tasks a Gantt task waits for

revenue-growth.title: Revenue and growth on two axes
revenue-growth.description: Revenue as bars on the left axis, the growth rate as a line on the right axis (yAxis: "right").

climate.title: Climate chart
climate.description: Monthly precipitation as bars and the mean temperature as a smooth line; the crosshair reads both.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
